entities.summary: The Cama & Albless Hospital is a hospital for women and children in the city of Mumbai, India, with 367 beds. Since May 2024, it is has offered its assisted reproductive technology (ART) services for free, making it a first public-run hospital in Maharashtra to do so. In 2008 it was one of the targets of the Mumbai terror attacks.
